LICENSE: CC0

Quoted from the asset page, 2026-10-05:

  "LICENSE (CC0)
   This asset pack can be used in both free and commercial projects.
   You can modify, remix, or build upon it as needed.
   Credit would be much appreciated.
   A link back to the original asset or my profile is appreciated!"

Credit is appreciated but not required. Stockwell credits it anyway in the
Credits screen (Phase 5).

NOTE: the downloaded archive (Supermercado.zip) contains no LICENSE file of its
own, so this file records the terms as stated on the asset page. The author also
states on that page: "Please note that they do not have the same size or
consistent scale." Stockwell normalises scale and pivots on import - see
Docs/ASSETS.md.
